In the United States, companies can buy and sell our personal data without users ever knowing, and it's completely legal. It sounds unbelievable, but it's an undeniable fact.

In theory, you can ask companies to delete your data from the internet, but that's easier said than done. The good news is that Incogni offers a service to handle it for you, and 9to5Mac readers can now enjoy an exclusive 45% off discount...

Your personal data is being sold publicly

Apple offers a range of features designed to help protect our online privacy, including 'App Tracking Transparency', 'Hide My Email', and 'iCloud Private Relay'. Making good use of these tools can prevent our digital footprint from being further exposed.

However, these features cannot handle personal data that has already been leaked. Most people are shocked to learn how much information marketers and scammers can obtain about them by purchasing data from data brokers.

Those 30-page terms and conditions you agree to when downloading a new app or signing up for a new website often contain seemingly harmless clauses, such as authorising the 'sharing of data with designated partners'. In reality, this means that sensitive data like your location history could be sold to data brokers and then resold to anyone who can afford to pay.

Data brokers collect personal data from multiple sources and compile it into a detailed personal profile. Companies can purchase this data and then send you massive amounts of spam. What's worse, once scammers obtain this information, they can impersonate familiar institutions to try and gain your trust.

Delete your family's personal data

In most US states, you have the legal right to request the deletion of your data from these databases. Unfortunately, the entire process is extremely time-consuming, as you must contact hundreds of companies one by one.

Each company deliberately designs the process to be extremely complicated to discourage users from trying. For example, you cannot submit a single application for your whole family; each family member must apply separately. Opt-out forms are often difficult to find, and the process frequently requires filling out lengthy and complicated application forms.

Even if you succeed, you still have to repeat the same process regularly in the future, as there is no mechanism to prevent them from purchasing your new data again.

Fortunately, Incogni offers a simpler solution

The good news is that Incogni can automate the entire process for you. After setting up an account, you can initiate the process for your whole family with just a few clicks.

Incogni will contact hundreds of data brokers on behalf of you and your family to request data removal. Incogni doesn't just handle it once; it repeats the process regularly to ensure your family's data doesn't reappear in these databases.

The result is that you will receive less spam and robocalls, and the chances of being targeted by scammers will be greatly reduced.
